name: MiliPoint: A Point Cloud Dataset for mmWave Radar
description: Public large-scale millimeter-wave radar point-cloud dataset for human activity recognition, supporting action classification, human identification, and keypoint estimation.
citation: Han Cui, Shu Zhong, Jiacheng Wu, Zichao Shen, Naim Dahnoun, and Yiren Zhao. MiliPoint: A Point Cloud Dataset for mmWave Radar. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 36:62713–62726, 2023. https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.13425
